battlecards.why_selected: Improved transportation and surcharge discounts without operational disruption; FedEx matched benchmark rates and granted fee waivers and favorable DIM factors.
battlecards.contract_terms: Revised pricing agreement executed 2022; late fee waiver through June 2023; credit card billing terms accepted until 2025; retained DIM factor 210.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Benchmark data with UPS GPO rates and threat of switching created competitive pressure on FedEx.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Nationwide network, existing integration with CJPP systems, reliable ground performance.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Higher fuel surcharges, limited improvement on Express services.
battlecards.switching_costs: System integrations, label printing updates, customer communication, staff retraining.
battlecards.notes: Savings validated using Jan–Feb 2022 shipment-level data and annualized to 339K.

battlecards.why_not_selected: FedEx matched or beat UPS GPO pricing and avoided system change costs.
battlecards.contract_terms: UPS GPO proposal included improved discounts and accessorial caps (not executed).
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: UPS GPO rates were used as a bargaining chip with FedEx.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Competitive GPO discounts, extensive network coverage.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Would require migration of shipping systems; limited flexibility on dimensional factors.
battlecards.switching_costs: System changes, label re-configuration, staff training.
battlecards.notes: Benchmark analyses run Aug–Sept 2021 informed negotiations.

battlecards.why_selected: Best overall value for Las Vegas site and agreed to operate a 3PL warehouse with no penalties for inventory aged >120 days.
battlecards.contract_terms: MOU executed March 2022; includes inventory return clause after 120 days; pricing term length not disclosed.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Multi-supplier RFP with potential single-source award for Las Vegas volumes.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Competitive pricing, willingness to hold inventory, national distribution capability.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Pricing for Harrisburg location less competitive than Colony Paper.
battlecards.switching_costs: Packaging spec validation and inventory transition.
battlecards.notes: Sigma to provide best-and-final pricing for Storopack items during implementation.

battlecards.why_selected: Delivered 22% savings for Harrisburg facility and executed contract quickly.
battlecards.contract_terms: MOU executed 28 Apr 2022; pricing firm for initial term (length not specified).
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: BAFO round created price tension versus Sigma.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Aggressive pricing, regional warehousing near Harrisburg.

battlecards.why_selected: Lowest pricing for Harrisburg and agreed to 2%30Net60 payment terms.
battlecards.contract_terms: MOU with option Net30 or 2%30Net60; length not specified.
battlecards.switching_costs: Possible tooling or die costs for custom boxes.
battlecards.notes: Cash-flow benefit of $2668 if Net60 terms used.

battlecards.why_selected: Local presence in Las Vegas and ability to meet service requirements.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Proximity to Vegas facility, quick lead times.
battlecards.switching_costs: Packaging spec alignment and potential tooling.
battlecards.notes: Additional $3960 savings possible with early-pay discount.

battlecards.why_selected: Access to Omnia Partners GPO rates delivered 13% markup reduction and nationwide capability.
battlecards.contract_terms: Participation agreement via Omnia Partners executed 2022; standard GPO terms.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Pre-negotiated GPO pricing and consolidated volume.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Scale, wage analysis support, flexible staffing models.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Initial communication issues with local branch; requested rate increases in PA.
battlecards.switching_costs: Onboarding new temps and potential turnover impact.
battlecards.notes: CJPP net savings after Treya fee estimated at 8%.

alternatives_considered: Existing LTL carrier base (YRC, Old Dominion, Estes, etc.)

battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Tool limited to 50 line items; longer implementation timeline; waived claims did not yield additional discounts.
